primary_work.title: Grounding Before Generalizing: How AI Differs from Humans in Causal Transfer
primary_work.official_code_status: linked by author page but returned HTTP 404 at audit time

decision: NARROWED BEYOND BEHAVIOURAL INTERACTIVE CAUSAL TRANSFER — NOT ADOPTED
rejected_claims: interactive text-based causal discovery is itself a new RQ-001 contribution
surface-remapped OpenLock transfer identifies an unknown latent intervention partition
first-solution transfer gains identify raw-language equivalence
text-versus-image performance differences establish causal-representation identifiability
remaining_rq: After controlling for interactive action/outcome histories and behavioural structure-transfer information of the OpenLock kind, can an externally anchored population language channel supply a target distinction unavailable from the interaction process, strictly reduce the residual causal equivalence class, and jointly identify raw-utterance equivalence with a refined latent intervention-target partition?
counterexample: Two distinct latent partitions and utterance-equivalence maps can induce the same policy on every reachable OpenLock interaction history, yielding identical actions, solutions, success and attempt counts; behavioural transfer therefore does not uniquely identify either internal object.
